caption_only.title: High-Engagement Post: Building the Content Engine in Public
caption_only.text:
Here's why building the content engine in public is bringing me one step closer to the Maserati.

Here are 3 truths every South African business owner needs to remember:

1. Your customers are 80%+ on mobile phones — if your site takes 4 seconds to load, they bounce.
2. Trust is built by clear pricing, real local reviews, and effortless contact.
3. Simplicity always outperforms unnecessary animations and bloated code.

Key Takeaway: Just finished shipping the first automated educational content batch for LaunchGremlin. Tested the business card generator with local entrepreneurs in Durban. Proof that speed beats polish every time ...
